title: Late-label stage closed contract, freeze revision 1
id_version_note: v3 chosen deliberately: studio.render.final.v2 / profile.v2 are reserved by the rev-4 output-settings negotiation, so every ID minted here skips v2.

integrates_with.recipe_shape_unchanged: operations[] + manifest[] with recipe_digest/manifest_digest/packet_digest; manifest entries remain exactly {logical_id, safe_name, role, sha256, size_bytes} with ref-role bijection
integrates_with.stage_decision: new operation kind 'late_label_stage' inserted in STAGES AFTER 'presentation_frame' and BEFORE 'logo'; additive entry + additive singleton-allowlist exemption (kind is repeatable, one operation per cue, unlike the singleton kinds)
integrates_with.local_reference: electron/server/generators/video.ts sections 6c (7507-7604) and 7 stay authoritative and unmoved: cues burn after frame/subtitles, before logo; no local reorder
integrates_with.profile_descriptor_id: studio.render.profile.v3 (repinned profile/tools/compiler digests ship with the stage; sameDescriptorPins then matches only builds carrying the stage)
integrates_with.digest_rule: packet/recipe/manifest digests keep render-hash-v1 typed binary canonicalization — domain 'studio.render.hash.v1\0<kind>\0', C(value) encoding — NEVER JSON-stringify canonical SHA. (The freeze hashes of THIS file are plain UTF-8 SHA-256 of the file bytes.)
integrates_with.descriptor_shape: Profile/compiler keys unchanged from v1; only the listed literals and real artifact/dependency hashes change. production_eligible stays false. Qualification fields remain exact evidence or null; protocol support grants no admission. No v2 output-settings changes.

capability.negotiation: Story adds requested_contract=studio.render.late-label.v3 to GET /v1/final-renders/capabilities only for cue compositions. Gateway accepts one exact requested_contract string; duplicates/unknown values refuse. Only that scoped response may include late_labels and the v3 profile/compiler pair. No-query/old clients keep the existing response and v1 profile. Older Gateway ignoring the query returns no late_labels: loud local fallback. Story rejects unsolicited late_labels, malformed records, wrong format, duplicate/missing/unknown motions. Existing identity/freshness/digest/pin checks remain mandatory.

cue_id.note: Story derives it from the reviewed cue id (lowercase, sanitized); it is packet identity only — no episode/preset/plan data rides here (AGENTS §4/§5)

enable.clock: COMPOSED clock — Story applies sceneTimelineOffsetSec before the packet exists; the reviewed window itself is never mutated

placement.fit_rule: x_px + label_width <= canvas.width AND y_px + label_height <= canvas.height, checked at staging where asset dimensions are known; resolution to pixels replaces drawtext's per-frame text_w/text_h anchors
placement.line_note: leader-line assets are full-canvas and overlay at 0,0 — they carry no placement

entrance_sec.note: Exact current local entrance; no new user setting.

label.rule: required for every motion EXCEPT wipe; null exactly when motion == 'wipe' (the reveal frames carry the label)

frames.length: L = max(2, ceil(working_fps * duration_sec) + 1)  — the exact count writeLabelRevealFrames produces
frames.progress: i / (L - 1) for index i in order; order is the play order

reveal.rule: required exactly when motion == 'wipe'; null otherwise

line.rule: present only for a pointing design with a usable target; mutually exclusive with line_reveal; Story drops line-draw to pop pre-packet when no target exists (labelCueForRender), so a line-draw op without a line never reaches the wire

line_reveal.frames: same L/progress rule as reveal; full-canvas frames
line_reveal.rule: required exactly when motion == 'line-draw'; null otherwise

per_cue_invariants: motion 'line-draw' => label non-null, reveal null, line null, line_reveal non-null
any other motion => reveal null, line_reveal null, label non-null
at most one of line and line_reveal is non-null (both may be null)
one operation per cue; cue_id unique within the recipe

operation.gate_note: recipe.effects_gate does NOT apply to late_label_stage; the op's own enable window is the only timing authority (matches local: cue suppression comes from cue timestamps, not a filter gate)

assets_and_manifest.role_extension: FinalRenderAssetRole += 'cue_label' (additive; ref-role bijection enforced by the existing manifest validator)
assets_and_manifest.naming_rule: For operation index c and frame index i, logical_id = cue_<c as 4 decimal digits>_<purpose> where purpose is label, line, r<i as4digits>, lr<i as4digits>. c/i must fit 0000..9999; otherwise refuse before intent. safe_name=logical_id+.png. IDs are independent of user cue_id; uniqueness and SAFE_NAME bounds are checked, never assumed. No stored cue is rewritten.
assets_and_manifest.transfer: explicit bounded asset refs only — no wildcard/pattern filenames (no %04d), no node paths, no font files, no raw FFmpeg strings anywhere in the packet

per_motion_inventory.none|pop|slide|float|pulse: 1 label png (+1 line png when pointing)
per_motion_inventory.wipe: L reveal pngs (L = max(2, ceil(working_fps*duration_sec)+1)) (+1 line png when pointing)
per_motion_inventory.line-draw: 1 label png + L full-canvas line reveal pngs
per_motion_inventory.worst_case_assets: All existing recipe source requirements plus sum(per-cue inventory). Count unique manifest entries, including overlays, logo and frame assets, not merely base+audio.

png_encoding.alpha: straight RGBA, no palette, no APNG animation chunks
png_encoding.label_still: the transparent PNG renderLabelDesign already produces (sharp/Pango, local font pool thumbnail-fonts.ts — fonts never cross the wire)
png_encoding.wipe_frames: every frame the SAME width x height as the label still: content = left-prefix crop of width round(W*progress) composited on a transparent canvas of full size (frame 0 fully transparent, frame L-1 byte-identical in content to the still)
png_encoding.line_still: full-canvas W x H transparent PNG (renderLeaderLine output)
png_encoding.line_reveal_frames: full-canvas W x H transparent PNGs, stroke grows with progress; frame L-1 = complete line
png_encoding.sha256: hex sha256 over the exact file bytes, as today
png_encoding.validation: Validate byte hash/size plus decoded PNG facts and dimensions before use. Repeated refs with incompatible expected dimensions refuse. All frames of a reveal have equal dimensions.

clock_and_eof.enable: evaluated against the PRIMARY video input's timestamp t: between(t, start_sec, end_sec) — same value local emits after the offset is applied
clock_and_eof.still_inputs: repeated still (loop_still, decoder png); scale motions (pop/pulse) require per-frame evaluation and looping at working_fps — compiler-internal, never wire fields
clock_and_eof.overlay_end: eof_action=repeat; primary video controls EOF. Pop/pulse loop at working_fps and retain local shortest=1 (shortest input is primary video; cue is infinite). Finite PNG sequences and static/offset-only inputs must NOT use shortest=1, so reveal EOF never truncates primary. Final output remains bounded by target duration.
clock_and_eof.reveal_start: reveal/line-reveal frame 0 begins exactly at enable.start_sec (local sets reveal_start=start for wipe and setpts-shifts line-draw by the same composed start); frames advance at recipe canvas.working_fps
clock_and_eof.exit: hard off at enable.end_sec — the image-label path has no alpha ramp (the drawtext alpha/slide exit belongs to the legacy lane, out of scope)
clock_and_eof.reveal_assembly: Receiver creates a private trusted image2 sequence by copying/linking the explicitly ordered validated PNG refs to locally generated contiguous filenames; only receiver-generated paths/pattern are passed to FFmpeg. Sender never supplies pattern/path. Input framerate=working_fps; frame i PTS=i/working_fps+enable.start_sec, so final frame begins at (L-1)/fps (may exceed0.3 at nonintegral fps*0.3). Preserve this local discrete timing; do not resample or stretch.
clock_and_eof.rounding: Enable and reveal-start expressions use toFixed(3), matching current local helper. Motion/placement formulas below are normative; use FFmpeg expression escaping from existing helpers.

limits_accounting.rule: all bounds are read live from FinalRenderCapabilities.execution_bounds at admission; nothing here is a new published number
limits_accounting.max_operations: existing ops + 1 per cue must be <= published max_operations
limits_accounting.max_assets: Count every existing source requirement plus every distinct cue asset; total must be <= published max_assets.
limits_accounting.max_asset_bytes / max_total_input_bytes: per-file and summed sizes checked against the published figures before any intent is staged
limits_accounting.max_pixel_frames / max_duration_sec / ca: unchanged — the stage adds no output frames
limits_accounting.breach_behavior: pre-accept refusal: render stays local with the existing loud sentence pattern naming the exact published figure the packet exceeded (limit shown, AGENTS §1); the pinned-lineage rule still overrides (known lineage => throw until reconciled)
limits_accounting.gap: the exact published max_assets/max_asset_bytes values were not read in this read-only pass — they are live capability data; the formulas above bind to whatever the Gateway publishes.

refusal_and_fallback.pre_accept: any refusal before staging returns local with one loud output_lines reason; if a staged lineage is known (pinned intent + descriptor pins), the fallback THROWS until the pinned node/key is reconciled
refusal_and_fallback.post_accept: definite refusal => phase 'refused' => local; uncertain POST outcome => phase 'send_unknown' => THROWS until lookupFinalRenderByKey settles it; unknown never renders local

reasons.contextual_cues: capability absent/unreadable, or any cue shape outside this contract — today's reason, kept
reasons.contextual_cues_drawtext: NEW, distinct, loud: a cue using one of the four legacy drawtext templates (documentary-label, map-pin, archival-caption, chapter-plate) — stays local; never silently skipped, never partially staged
reasons.late_label_bounds: NEW: this stage would exceed a published execution bound (figure named in the sentence)
reasons.contextual_cues_unknown_template: Unknown template; no partial cue staging.

digest_and_freeze.runtime_digests: render-hash-v1 typed binary canonicalization for recipe/manifest/packet (see integrates_with.digest_rule)
digest_and_freeze.freeze_hashes: plain UTF-8 SHA-256 of the two freeze files, reported alongside them

scope_honesty.in_scope: image-backed 'label:' cues only: still PNG, leader line, motions none/pop/slide/float/pulse/wipe/line-draw, composed-clock enable, remote via the one paired Gateway
out_of_scope_and_still_local: four legacy drawtext templates — investigation result: feasible later by reusing label-design-render.ts (sharp/Pango + local font pool) to render transparent cue PNGs, but glyph rasterization cannot be byte-identical to FFmpeg drawtext, so historical local look would not be preserved; redesign explicitly NOT part of this freeze
subtitles, scene effects, episode stack: their existing refusals stand — a working late-label stage does NOT imply those lanes render remotely
scope_honesty.parity_claim: this contract covers label-stage parity only; it claims no whole-renderer parity

dependencies_note: no schema validator installed (no Ajv/jsonschema) and none to be added — lead validates the two files with bounded structural checks

motion_formulas.substitution: START=enable.start_sec.toFixed(3); END=(enable.start_sec+0.3).toFixed(3); base placement unchanged (scale uses top-left anchor, no implicit recenter). Leader line is composited before label at0,0; cues preserve reviewed array order.

context_validation: All numbers finite and integral magnitudes safe; ID/ref names unique/bijective; manifests exactly match roles cue_label and explicit PNG names.
0 <= start < end <= target duration. cue_id unique per recipe. Stage order frame -> late labels -> logo; repeated late labels permitted.
For each reveal: L=max(2,ceil(working_fps*0.3)+1), length=L, progress at index i equals i/(L-1). working_fps belongs to existing set5,24,25,30,60.
PNG dimensions bound placement/full-canvas line facts; enforce live execution bounds over ALL assets/operations.

Unknown capabilities fail closed as discovery error, not measured unsupported. No packet intent or asset upload before support/bounds validation; known lineage still requires original-key reconciliation.
